release_milestones.note: v3 was the launch compute series for flexible server; it reached GA with the service.

Burstable tier, B1ms / B2s / B2ms
release_milestones.note: The original burstable sizes; GA with flexible server.

release_milestones.label: Burstable tier, B4ms / B8ms / B12ms / B16ms / B20ms
Intel v5 compute series (Ddsv5 General Purpose, Edsv5 Memory Optimized)
release_milestones.note: Announced 2023-06-05 covering the May 2023 release; listed in the May 2023 release notes.

release_milestones.label: AMD v5 compute series (Dadsv5 General Purpose, Eadsv5 Memory Optimized)
release_milestones.note: Rolled out during 2023 after the Intel v5 series; reserved capacity for both Intel and AMD v5 SKUs landed in September 2024. Exact GA month not confirmed.

release_milestones.label: v6 compute series (Ddsv6 / Dadsv6 General Purpose, Edsv6 / Eadsv6 Memory Optimized)
release_milestones.note: PUBLIC PREVIEW as of the catalog date. Scaling between Burstable and v6 is not supported, and virtual network integration is not supported on v6.
